annotations.title: Inburgering: where to start and questions

description: For anyone who has to do inburgering (Dutch civic integration) and doesn't know how it works. Without a question: a start-here overview (route, exams, booking, exam day, results). With a question (booking, DigiD, exam day rules, what each exam part looks like, KNM, results and waiting times, A2 vs B1): checked passages from Kora's guides with official sources and a last-checked date.

question.description: The user's question in a few words, in English or Dutch, e.g. 'how do I book the exam' or 'how long are results'.
